fields.name: periodType
fields.description: Stats window for all summary fields except uTime . last_7d last_30d this_month last_month total today this_week custom : pass begin and end to define a custom window. The default is total .

fields.name: begin
fields.description: Custom stats-window start, Unix timestamp in millisecond format. Required when periodType=custom , together with end . Inclusive.

fields.name: end
fields.description: Custom stats-window end, Unix timestamp in millisecond format. Required when periodType=custom , together with begin . Inclusive.

fields.name: uid
fields.description: UID of the invitee. Only applicable to the UID of invitee master account. The data returned covers invitee master account and invitee sub-accounts.

fields.name: periodType
fields.description: Stats window for volPeriod . last_7d last_30d this_month last_month total today this_week When omitted, volPeriod is not returned. custom is not supported on this endpoint; custom or any unknown value returns 51000 .

fields.name: page
fields.description: 1-indexed page number. Non-numeric values fall back to 1 . The default is 1 .

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Items per page. Clamped to [1, 100] . The default is 100 .

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Search by UID or channel name.

fields.name: commissionCategory
fields.description: Commission calculation category. SPOT DERIVATIVE BSC

fields.name: orderBy
fields.description: Sort field. cTime depAmt vol fee rebate The default is cTime .

fields.name: orderDir
fields.description: Sort direction. asc desc The default is desc .

fields.name: kycStatus
fields.description: KYC status. unverified verified (passed at least KYC2)

fields.name: subAffiliateUid
fields.description: Filter invitees under a specific sub-affiliate (external UID).

fields.name: uid
fields.description: External user UIDs for exact match — the same UID returned as uid in the response. Single UID or up to 100 UIDs, comma-separated, e.g. 835449167911924693,835449167911924700 . Unknown UIDs are silently skipped; if none resolve, an empty page is returned (never the full list).

fields.name: joinTimeBegin
fields.description: Filter lower bound on joinTime (the relationship-established time), Unix timestamp in millisecond format. Inclusive. Required when joinTimeEnd is supplied; the two must be sent together. Independent of the periodType / begin / end stats window.

fields.name: joinTimeEnd
fields.description: Filter upper bound on joinTime (the relationship-established time), Unix timestamp in millisecond format. Inclusive. Required when joinTimeBegin is supplied; the two must be sent together. Independent of the periodType / begin / end stats window.

fields.description: Items per page. Clamped to [1, 100] . The default is 100 .
